hint: Twelve is made of one ten and two ones. Multiplying by each of those parts is easier than multiplying by twelve all at once.

hints.text: Twelve is made of one ten and two ones. Multiplying by each of those parts is easier than multiplying by twelve all at once.
Split $12$ into $10 + 2$. Work out $203 \times 10$ and $203 \times 2$, and then add those two partial products.

explanation: Split the second factor into parts that are easy to use: $12 = 10 + 2$.
Multiply by the ten: $203 \times 10 = 2030$, which is $203$ with a zero attached.
Multiply by the two: $203 \times 2 = 406$, which is $203$ doubled.
Add the partial products to get all twelve groups: $2030 + 406 = 2436$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Watch the zero
steps: The $0$ in the tens place of $203$ is not a mistake — it means zero tens.
In the standard algorithm you still write a $0$ in that column so the other digits stay lined up.
